flags.why: Everyday Vietnamese also uses dị ứng to mean strongly disliking or reacting negatively to something.
flags.fix: to have a strong aversion to; to strongly dislike

flags.why: Sét meaning 'rust' is mainly Southern usage.
Làn meaning a shopping basket is mainly Northern usage.
The example explains what căng means instead of demonstrating its use.
flags.fix: Con căng chuyền từ cành này sang cành khác. = The macaque swung from one branch to another.

flags.why: Tươi contrasts fresh or unpreserved food with dried or preserved food, but does not mean uncooked.
Cá tươi means fresh fish here, whereas 'raw fish' incorrectly specifies that it is uncooked.
flags.fix: He sells both dried fish and fresh fish.

flags.why: Nhân dân is a formal collective term used especially in official and political language.
